easy: Feeling safe and not worried.

ex.en: I felt secure when Dad held my hand.
ex.ko: 아빠가 내 손을 잡아 주어서 나는 안심이 되었다.

easy: To watch birds outside and learn about them.

ex.en: Grandpa likes to bird at the lake early in the morning.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아침 일찍 호숫가에서 새를 관찰하는 것을 좋아하신다.

easy: Saying that something bad is someone's fault.

ex.en: Tom took the blame for the broken window.
ex.ko: 톰은 깨진 창문의 책임을 졌다.

easy: To move up and down again and again in a small way.

ex.en: The little boat bobbed on the waves.
ex.ko: 작은 보트가 파도 위에서 위아래로 흔들렸다.

easy: To roll a ball along the ground.

ex.en: I bowled the ball and knocked down nine pins.
ex.ko: 나는 공을 굴려 핀을 아홉 개 쓰러뜨렸다.

easy: Having won first place in a contest.

ex.en: My neighbor's champion dog won a big prize.
ex.ko: 이웃집 우승견이 큰 상을 받았다.

easy: To speak up and fight for something to keep it safe.

ex.en: She always champions kids who are treated unfairly.
ex.ko: 그녀는 부당한 대우를 받는 아이들을 늘 옹호한다.

easy: A word that means the opposite of another word.

ex.en: "Hot" is the opposite of "cold".
ex.ko: "뜨겁다"의 반대말은 "차갑다"이다.

easy: Having the color of a pumpkin or a carrot.

ex.en: She wore an orange raincoat to school.
ex.ko: 그녀는 주황색 비옷을 입고 학교에 갔다.

easy: To tell someone something with your hands or a sign, without talking.

ex.en: The coach signaled the team to run.
ex.ko: 코치는 팀에게 달리라고 신호를 보냈다.

easy: A person who does not like big changes and likes old ways.

ex.en: My grandfather is a conservative who still uses his old radio.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아직도 낡은 라디오를 쓰는 보수적인 분이시다.

easy: To really wish to have or do something.

ex.en: I desire a puppy for my birthday.
ex.ko: 나는 생일 선물로 강아지를 간절히 원한다.

easy: Played or sung by one person alone.

ex.en: She played a solo song on the violin at school.
ex.ko: 그녀는 학교에서 바이올린 독주곡을 연주했다.

easy: By yourself, with no one else.

ex.en: Dad let me ride my bike solo for the first time.
ex.ko: 아빠는 처음으로 내가 혼자서 자전거를 타게 해 주셨다.

easy: The very most or the very farthest of something.

ex.en: Some people go to extremes, like eating only candy.
ex.ko: 어떤 사람들은 사탕만 먹는 것처럼 극단으로 치닫는다.

easy: The biggest amount that is possible.

ex.en: The elevator's maximum load is ten people.
ex.ko: 그 엘리베이터의 최대 정원은 열 명이다.

easy: To keep something to use later.

ex.en: Mom reserved some cake for my little brother.
ex.ko: 엄마는 남동생을 위해 케이크를 조금 남겨 두셨다.

easy: To move a boat using long poles called oars.

ex.en: We rowed the boat across the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 보트의 노를 저어 호수를 건넜다.

easy: Having nothing inside.

ex.en: My water bottle is empty.
ex.ko: 내 물병이 비었다.

easy: Telling you to be careful.

ex.en: Mom gave me a warning look when I ran inside.
ex.ko: 내가 집 안에서 뛰자 엄마가 경고하는 눈빛을 보내셨다.

easy: To put a picture inside a frame.

ex.en: Dad framed my drawing and hung it on the wall.
ex.ko: 아빠는 내 그림을 액자에 넣어 벽에 거셨다.

easy: To touch someone gently with your lips to show love.

ex.en: I kissed my grandma on the cheek.
ex.ko: 나는 할머니의 볼에 뽀뽀했다.

easy: A teacher who works at a college.

ex.en: My aunt is an academic who teaches science at a university.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 대학에서 과학을 가르치는 교수이시다.

easy: To put a liquid into bottles.

ex.en: Grandma bottled the juice from her garden fruit.
ex.ko: 할머니는 텃밭 과일로 만든 주스를 병에 담으셨다.

easy: To crowd close together in a group.

ex.en: The scared puppies bunched together under the bed.
ex.ko: 겁먹은 강아지들이 침대 밑에 한데 모였다.

easy: To eat less or only certain foods to be healthy or lose weight.

ex.en: Grandpa is dieting to keep his heart healthy.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 심장 건강을 위해 식이요법을 하고 계신다.

easy: To write instructions that tell a computer what to do.

ex.en: I programmed a simple game on my computer.
ex.ko: 나는 컴퓨터로 간단한 게임을 프로그래밍했다.

easy: In a firm way, so it will not come loose.

ex.en: Hold tight to the rope!
ex.ko: 밧줄을 꽉 잡아!

easy: To close a coat or shirt with buttons.

ex.en: Button your coat; it is cold outside.
ex.ko: 밖이 추우니 외투 단추를 채워라.

easy: To answer back, often by disagreeing.

ex.en: When I said it was easy, my brother countered that it was hard.
ex.ko: 내가 쉽다고 하자 형은 어렵다고 반박했다.

easy: To put a crown on someone to make them a king or queen.

ex.en: The queen was crowned in a big old church.
ex.ko: 여왕은 크고 오래된 교회에서 왕관을 썼다.

easy: To say that you do not agree with something.

ex.en: I objected when my brother took my seat.
ex.ko: 동생이 내 자리를 차지하자 나는 반대했다.

easy: When the police take away a person who did something wrong.

ex.en: The police made an arrest after the robbery.
ex.ko: 경찰은 강도 사건 후 체포를 했다.

easy: To go around something in a loop.

ex.en: The airplane circled the airport before landing.
ex.ko: 비행기는 착륙하기 전에 공항 위를 빙 돌았다.

easy: To make something messy or not clean.

ex.en: Don't dirty your clothes in the mud.
ex.ko: 진흙에서 옷을 더럽히지 마라.

easy: To cover something with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: The jeweler plated the ring with gold.
ex.ko: 보석 가게 주인은 반지에 금도금을 했다.

easy: To put a roof on a house or building.

ex.en: Workers roofed the new house in two days.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 이틀 만에 새집에 지붕을 얹었다.

easy: A bad feeling you get when you did something wrong.

ex.en: I felt shame when I told a lie.
ex.ko: 나는 거짓말을 하고 부끄러움을 느꼈다.

easy: The very end of something, like the point of a pencil.

ex.en: The tip of my pencil broke.
ex.ko: 내 연필 끝이 부러졌다.

easy: Staying quiet and steady in your mind when things are hard.

ex.en: She showed calm when the lights went out.
ex.ko: 그녀는 불이 나갔을 때 침착함을 보였다.

easy: From Ireland, or about Ireland and its people.

ex.en: We ate Irish soda bread on St. Patrick's Day.
ex.ko: 우리는 성 패트릭의 날에 아일랜드 소다빵을 먹었다.

easy: To see something, often from far away.

ex.en: We sighted a whale from the boat.
ex.ko: 우리는 배에서 고래를 발견했다.

easy: To make something not dry.

ex.en: Wet the sponge before you wipe the table.
ex.ko: 식탁을 닦기 전에 스펀지를 적셔라.

easy: A change that makes something better by fixing what is wrong.

ex.en: The school made a reform to give kids more time for recess.
ex.ko: 학교는 아이들의 쉬는 시간을 늘리는 개혁을 했다.

easy: To taste a little bit of something.

ex.en: We sampled cheese at the store.
ex.ko: 우리는 가게에서 치즈를 시식했다.

easy: Feeling pain or sadness.

ex.en: The suffering puppy got help from the vet.
ex.ko: 아파하던 강아지는 수의사의 도움을 받았다.

easy: Not able to see.

ex.en: My neighbor is blind, and her dog helps her cross the street.
ex.ko: 우리 이웃은 앞을 못 보는데, 그분의 개가 길 건너는 것을 도와준다.

easy: To make someone unable to see.

ex.en: The bright light blinded me for a moment.
ex.ko: 밝은 빛 때문에 잠깐 앞이 안 보였다.

easy: To tell someone the main facts they need to know.

ex.en: The coach briefed the team before the game.
ex.ko: 코치는 경기 전에 선수들에게 핵심을 간략히 알려 주었다.

easy: To give official permission to do something.

ex.en: The state licensed my aunt to drive a school bus.
ex.ko: 주 정부는 이모에게 스쿨버스를 운전할 면허를 내주었다.

easy: A colored liquid you spread on a wall or paper.

ex.en: I spilled red paint on the floor.
ex.ko: 나는 바닥에 빨간 페인트를 쏟았다.

easy: Light red in color.

ex.en: My sister has a pink backpack.
ex.ko: 내 여동생은 분홍색 책가방이 있다.

easy: The white cloud that rises from hot water.

ex.en: Steam rose from my hot soup.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 수프에서 김이 올라왔다.

easy: To see something happen.

ex.en: I witnessed my dog jump into the pool.
ex.ko: 나는 우리 개가 수영장에 뛰어드는 것을 보았다.

easy: To cover the top of something.

ex.en: Snow capped the mountain tops.
ex.ko: 눈이 산꼭대기를 덮고 있었다.

easy: A tool that keeps a door or box shut until you use a key.

ex.en: I lost the key to the lock on my bike.
ex.ko: 나는 자전거 자물쇠 열쇠를 잃어버렸다.

easy: A show with songs and dancing that tells a story.

ex.en: We saw a musical about a singing family.
ex.ko: 우리는 노래하는 가족에 관한 뮤지컬을 보았다.

easy: A light, strong material made in factories, used for toys and bottles.

ex.en: My water bottle is made of plastic.
ex.ko: 내 물병은 플라스틱으로 만들어졌다.

easy: A person the police think may have done something wrong.

ex.en: The police asked the suspect some questions.
ex.ko: 경찰은 용의자에게 몇 가지를 물었다.

easy: To fasten something with a rope or string.

ex.en: Tie your shoelaces before you run.
ex.ko: 달리기 전에 신발 끈을 묶어라.

easy: To write down or take pictures of what happens, step by step.

ex.en: Our class documented the plant's growth with photos every week.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 매주 사진으로 식물이 자라는 모습을 기록했다.

easy: From Greece, or about Greece and its people.

ex.en: We read a Greek myth about a winged horse.
ex.ko: 우리는 날개 달린 말이 나오는 그리스 신화를 읽었다.

easy: To lift something up onto your shoulders.

ex.en: Dad shouldered my heavy backpack.
ex.ko: 아빠가 내 무거운 책가방을 어깨에 메셨다.

easy: To look very tall and big next to other things.

ex.en: The tall tree towers over our house.
ex.ko: 그 키 큰 나무가 우리 집 위로 우뚝 솟아 있다.

easy: A person who is about the same age as you.

ex.en: My grandfather and his contemporaries grew up without phones.
ex.ko: 할아버지와 동년배 분들은 휴대전화 없이 자라셨다.

easy: To feel very proud of something you can do.

ex.en: She prides herself on her neat handwriting.
ex.ko: 그녀는 단정한 글씨를 자랑스러워한다.

easy: To notice something with your nose.

ex.en: I smelled cookies baking as soon as I walked in.
ex.ko: 들어서자마자 쿠키 굽는 냄새가 났다.

easy: One of the five parts at the end of your hand.

ex.en: I pinched my finger in the door.
ex.ko: 나는 문에 손가락이 끼었다.

easy: To put something in your pocket.

ex.en: I pocketed the coin and ran to the shop.
ex.ko: 나는 동전을 주머니에 넣고 가게로 달려갔다.

easy: A mark in music that tells you to play a note a little higher.

ex.en: The song has a sharp on the F.
ex.ko: 그 곡에는 파 음에 올림표가 붙어 있다.

easy: To hurt or damage something.

ex.en: Throwing trash in the river harms the fish.
ex.ko: 강에 쓰레기를 버리면 물고기에게 해가 된다.

easy: To get thinner.

ex.en: The ice on the pond thinned in the warm sun.
ex.ko: 연못의 얼음이 따뜻한 햇볕에 얇아졌다.

easy: Last, at the end.

ex.en: The closing song of the show made everyone clap.
ex.ko: 공연의 마지막 노래에 모두가 박수를 쳤다.

easy: A person who has a higher job or rank than you.

ex.en: The new worker asked her superior for help.
ex.ko: 새 직원은 상급자에게 도움을 청했다.

easy: A liquid that tastes sour and can burn things.

ex.en: Lemon juice has a weak acid in it.
ex.ko: 레몬즙에는 약한 산이 들어 있다.

easy: To gently stroke an animal with your hand.

ex.en: I petted the lamb at the farm.
ex.ko: 나는 농장에서 새끼 양을 쓰다듬었다.

easy: A mark left behind by something that went by.

ex.en: The snail left a shiny trail on the path.
ex.ko: 달팽이가 길에 반짝이는 자국을 남겼다.

easy: A hard gray building material used for sidewalks and walls.

ex.en: The sidewalk is made of concrete.
ex.ko: 그 인도는 콘크리트로 만들어졌다.

easy: The perfect thing that you hope to reach one day.

ex.en: Her ideal is to be a kind and fair leader.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이상은 친절하고 공정한 지도자가 되는 것이다.

easy: To have a place in a list from first to last.

ex.en: Our team ranks third in the league.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 리그에서 3위를 차지하고 있다.

easy: To stick something to a surface with tape.

ex.en: I taped my poster to the wall.
ex.ko: 나는 포스터를 벽에 테이프로 붙였다.

easy: To stand up on the back legs, like a scared horse.

ex.en: The horse reared up when the dog barked.
ex.ko: 개가 짖자 말이 뒷발로 일어섰다.

easy: At the back.

ex.en: The rear door of the bus was open.
ex.ko: 버스의 뒷문이 열려 있었다.

easy: To make someone feel mad.

ex.en: Losing the game angered my brother.
ex.ko: 경기에서 져서 형이 화가 났다.

easy: To sing very loudly and with a lot of power.

ex.en: She belted out her favorite song in the car.
ex.ko: 그녀는 차 안에서 좋아하는 노래를 크게 불렀다.

easy: To open up into flowers.

ex.en: The cherry tree bloomed in spring.
ex.ko: 벚나무에 봄이 되자 꽃이 피었다.

easy: A thin, narrow opening in something.

ex.en: A mouse slipped through a crack in the wall.
ex.ko: 생쥐가 벽의 갈라진 틈으로 빠져나갔다.

easy: Tiny bits of dry dirt that float in the air.

ex.en: Dust floated in the sunlight.
ex.ko: 먼지가 햇빛 속에 떠다녔다.

easy: A change to a smaller or lower amount.

ex.en: There was a decline in rain this summer.
ex.ko: 이번 여름에는 비가 줄었다.

easy: To or in the busy middle part of a city.

ex.en: We walked downtown to see the parade.
ex.ko: 우리는 퍼레이드를 보러 시내로 걸어갔다.

easy: A small jump, often on one foot.

ex.en: The rabbit made a hop over the log.
ex.ko: 토끼가 통나무 위를 깡충 뛰어넘었다.

easy: A person whose job is to care for sick people.

ex.en: The nurse gave me a bandage.
ex.ko: 간호사가 내게 반창고를 붙여 주었다.

easy: To put a plant into a pot with soil.

ex.en: We potted the flowers and put them on the porch.
ex.ko: 우리는 꽃을 화분에 심어 현관에 놓았다.

easy: To rub something until it is flat and not bumpy.

ex.en: Smooth the clay with your thumb.
ex.ko: 엄지손가락으로 찰흙을 매끄럽게 만들어라.
